privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.ownerText: The data controller of the personal data collected through BikeMaster is:
privacy.dataTypesText: By using BikeMaster, we collect the following categories of data:
privacy.userDataBody: name, email, age, weight, height, medical data provided voluntarily in the athlete profile
privacy.gpsDataBody: geographic coordinates, route track, speed, altitude, heart rate, power, cadence, distance, elevation
privacy.geoDataBody: real-time position during GPS tracking from phone
privacy.externalDataBody: activity data from Strava, Garmin Connect, Google Fit (only if authorized by the user)
privacy.purposesText: Personal data is processed for the following purposes:
privacy.serviceProvisionBody: analysis of cycling performance, calculation of metrics (calories, TSS, CTL/ATL/TSB), generation of maps and reports
privacy.authBody: account management and access to the service
privacy.integrationsBody: synchronization with external services upon consent
privacy.improvementBody: aggregated and anonymized statistics to improve features
privacy.securityBody: protection from unauthorized access and anomaly detection
privacy.contractBody: processing necessary to provide the requested service (Art. 6, par. 1, lett. b GDPR)
privacy.consentBody: processing of health data and real-time geolocation (Art. 6, par. 1, lett. a GDPR)
privacy.legitimateBody: data security, aggregate statistics (Art. 6, par. 1, lett. f GDPR)
privacy.sensitiveText: The service collects potentially sensitive data including:
privacy.healthDataBody: heart rate, fatigue data, performance scores (Art. 9 GDPR)
privacy.geoBody: continuous GPS position during tracking from mobile device
privacy.sensitiveNote: Such data is processed exclusively upon explicit consent of the user and is used only for the purposes indicated in this notice.
privacy.sharingText: Personal data is not sold to third parties. It is shared exclusively with:
privacy.groqBody: training data for the AI Coach (does not share identifying data)
privacy.openaiBody: embeddings for semantic search in the Knowledge Base (anonymized data)
privacy.gpsTrackBody: retained until deletion by the user
privacy.jwtBody: retained for the duration of the session
privacy.rightsIntro: Under Articles 15-22 of the GDPR, the user has the right to:
privacy.cookiesText: For detailed information about cookies, consult the
privacy.changesText: Any changes will be communicated through the service or via email to registered users. We recommend consulting this page periodically.
privacy.authorityText: In case of no response or dissatisfaction, you can file a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante) at

terms.trackMobile: Track rides in real time from mobile device

terms.account2: The user must provide accurate and up-to-date information in the athlete profile
terms.account3: Each user is responsible for all activities carried out through their account
terms.account4: Sharing the account with unauthorized third parties is prohibited

terms.userData2: Granting a limited license to BikeMaster to process and display the data

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.whatText: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device while browsing a website. Cookies allow the site to recognize the user and store certain information to improve the user experience.
cookies.technicalText: These cookies are essential for the correct functioning of the BikeMaster service:
cookies.name: Name
cookies.analyticsText: Used to understand how users interact with the service (anonymized or aggregated):
cookies.usageStatsBody: pages visited, session duration, errors encountered
cookies.performanceBody: loading times, API calls, system metrics
cookies.thirdPartyText: Some cookies may be set by third-party services integrated in the service:
cookies.chartjsBody: no cookies of its own, data managed locally
cookies.thirdPartyNote: These third parties have their own privacy policies, not controlled by BikeMaster.
cookies.manageText: The user can manage cookies directly through the browser settings:
cookies.chromePath: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
cookies.firefoxPath: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and site data
cookies.edgePath: Settings → Privacy, search and services → Cookies
cookies.disableNote: Note: disabling technical cookies may compromise the functioning of the service and prevent access to the account.
cookies.mobileText: The BikeMaster Android mobile app, installed via APK, does not use traditional cookies. It uses instead:
cookies.gpsNote: Background GPS tracking requires location permission, managed by the Android operating system.
cookies.altTrackingText: In addition to cookies, BikeMaster may use:
cookies.localStorageToolBody: for data persistence in the browser
cookies.indexeddbBody: for advanced caching of activity data
cookies.updatesText: Any changes to this policy will be published on this page. We recommend consulting it periodically.
cookies.contactsText: For questions about cookies or tracking practices:

about.title: About Us
about.description: BikeMaster is a lifestyle health intelligence system — health state as dynamic balance of lifestyle variables, with cycling as the structured activity anchor.
about.whoWeAreText: BikeMaster is an open-source project dedicated to advanced analysis of cycling performance. Our mission is to provide professional tools for cyclists of every level, from beginners to competitive athletes, to understand and improve their performance through data, algorithms and artificial intelligence.
about.featurePerformanceText: Complete analysis of rides with advanced metrics: Normalized Power, TSS, FTP, Critical Power, CTL/ATL/TSB.
about.featureCoachText: Personalized training and recovery advice through LLM models and knowledge based on scientific data.
about.featureMapsText: Visualize routes colored by speed, GPS heatmaps, and road safety analysis.
about.featureMobileText: Record rides directly from your Android phone with foreground GPS service.
about.featureIntegrationsText: Sync with Strava, Garmin Connect and Google Fit to import all your activities.
about.featureBenchmarkText: Compare your performance with athletes in your category to understand your level.
about.technologyText: We build BikeMaster with modern and open-source technologies:
about.valueOpenSourceText: the code is public on GitHub under the MIT license
about.valuePrivacyText: your data is yours, we do not sell it to third parties
about.valueCommunityText: we develop with and for the cycling community
about.valueScientificText: algorithms based on physiological and scientific principles
about.contribute: Want to contribute or learn more?

help.title: BikeMaster Guide
help.welcomeStartText: Create a new account. After registration you will be redirected to the athlete profile to complete your data.
help.welcomeLoginText: Log in with a previously registered username and password.
help.welcomeGoogleText: Use your Google account to authenticate quickly without entering a password.
help.navRidesText: View the list of all your recorded rides, with filters by date and distance.
help.navDashboardText: Summary of main KPIs: total distance, calories, average speed and recent trends.
help.navTrackingText: Start a new ride in real time with GPS. Shows live map and instant metrics.
help.navImportText: Upload GPX/FIT files or sync from external services (Strava, Google Fit, Wahoo).
help.navAthleteText: Fill in your profile: weight, height, experience and goals. Required for personalized calculations.
help.navCoachText: Chat with the digital coach for advice on training, recovery and race strategy.
help.navKnowledgeText: Knowledge base with physiological principles and training rules used by the coach.
help.navBm2Text: BikeMaster 2.0 simulation engine: predictive models and performance algorithms.
help.navCalendarText: Plan weekly workouts and view workload over time.
help.navGranfondoText: Planning tool for granfondos and multi-day cycling events.
help.navMapsText: View your ride routes on an interactive map with elevation profile.
help.navAetherMapText: Advanced cartographic map for exploration and territorial analysis (R&D project).
help.navPoiText: Itineraries and points of interest: fountains, refreshments, views and technical points.
help.navHeatmapText: Density map of rides: most traveled areas, frequency and intensity.
help.navBadgeText: Achievement system: badges and objectives unlocked based on your performance.
help.navCompareText: Compare two rides or different periods to see improvements and differences.
help.navWeatherText: Weather forecast for the ride location. Includes wind, humidity and advice.
help.navSettingsText: Configure backend URL, personal API keys and sync mode.
help.navConnectionsText: Manage external services: connect/disconnect Strava, Google Fit, Wahoo and save API key.
help.navLogoutText: End the session and return to the login screen.
help.trackTypeText: Select the discipline: Bike, Run, Walk, Trekking, Indoor or Other. Influences calculated metrics.
help.trackStartText: Start GPS recording. Requires location permissions. The map updates in real time.
help.trackPauseText: Pause recording without losing accumulated data. Resume whenever you want.
help.trackResumeText: Resume tracking after a pause. Pause time is not counted.
help.trackStopText: End the session and generate the GPX file. You can upload it to BikeMaster or export it.
help.trackUploadText: Automatically send the just-tracked ride to the backend to save it in your account.
help.ridesTrackText: Go directly to the GPS tracking screen to start a new ride.
help.ridesPlanText: Open the calendar to organize the week's workouts.
help.ridesCoachText: Ask the digital coach for advice based on your recent ride data.
help.ridesListText: Each row shows date, distance, duration and average speed. Click to see full details.
help.importFileText: Drag files into the upload area or click to select them. Supports multiple files.
help.importGoogleFitText: Connect your Google Fit account to automatically import all activities.
help.importStravaText: Authorize Strava via OAuth to sync your cycling rides.
help.importDisconnectText: Revoke access to the external service. Already imported data remains saved.
help.setBackendText: Enter the address of your local backend (e.g. https://your-pc:8000). Leave empty to use same origin.
help.setSaveText: Save the custom URL or restore the default (same origin).
help.setFailoverText: Enable cloud backup on Render if the local backend does not respond.
help.setApiText: Enter your keys for Groq (AI Coach), Google Maps, SerpAPI and Weather. Saved only on the device.
help.setImportKeysText: Paste keys in JSON or KEY=VALUE format to import them in bulk.
help.setVerifyText: Test connectivity with the backend and show the current status (local / cloud / PC).
help.setSyncModeText: Choose between Local (Never) for 100% offline use or Cloud sync for optional bidirectional backup.
help.setExportText: Download a full backup of rides or restore from a previously exported file.
help.athBioText: Demographic data for personalized power and threshold calculations.
help.athFatText: Optional. Improves the accuracy of performance models.
help.athYearsText: Help the coach calibrate advice based on your experience.
help.athLevelText: From Beginner to Elite. Influences suggested training thresholds.
help.athGoalsText: Describe your goals (e.g. Gran Fondo, criterium). The coach will use them for plans.
help.athSaveText: Save the profile. On first login you will be automatically redirected to rides.
help.athScoresText: Calculate and display athlete scores based on the entered data.
help.coachChatText: Write free questions about training, recovery, nutrition or race strategy.
help.coachReportText: Generate a complete athlete report with scores, suggestions and areas for improvement.
help.coachClearText: Delete the current conversation to start a new dialogue.
help.coachQuickText: Use predefined suggestions to ask common advice without typing.
help.zone12Text: Active recovery and slow base. Foundation for building aerobic endurance.
help.zone57Text: Interval training and maximum threshold. Develops power and speed.
